lines.en: Where is Captain Alison going and how?
lines.cn: 艾莉森上尉要去哪里？又是如何前往那里的？

lines.en: Our neighbour, Captain Charles Alison, will sail from Portsmouth tomorrow.
lines.cn: 我们的邻居查尔斯·艾利森上尉明天将从朴次茅斯启航。

lines.en: We'll meet him at the harbour early in the morning.
lines.cn: 我们将在清晨在港口与他见面。

lines.en: He will be in his small boat, Topsail.
lines.cn: 他会待在他的小船上，那艘名叫“Topsail”的船。

lines.en: Topsail is a famous little boat.
It has sailed across the Atlantic many times.
lines.cn: 它已经多次横渡了大西洋。

lines.en: Captain Alison will set out at eight o'clock,
lines.cn: 艾莉森船长将在八点钟出发。

lines.en: so we'll have plenty of time.
lines.cn: 所以我们会有足够的时间。

lines.en: We'll see his boat and then we'll say goodbye to him.
lines.cn: 我们会看到他的船，然后向他道别。

lines.en: He will be away for two months.
We are very proud of him.
lines.cn: 我们为他感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: He will take part in an important race across the Atlantic.
lines.cn: 他将参加一场横跨大西洋的重要比赛。
